task: Predict TP53 mutation status in breast cancer. Classes: wildtype vs mutant. Look for high nuclear grade, marked pleomorphism, brisk mitotic activity, solid growth, and geographic necrosis that can accompany TP53-altered aggressive morphology.

classes.0: TP53 wildtype tumor with comparatively lower grade morphology and fewer extreme atypical mitotic or pleomorphic features.
classes.1: TP53 mutant tumor showing high-grade nuclei, marked pleomorphism, frequent mitoses, and often necrotic or pushing high-grade growth.
